try:
    valid = df[
        (df['row_kind'] != 'cancelled') &
        (~df['row_kind'].isin(['cancel', 'void', 'voided'])) &
        (df['Currency'] == 'USD')
    ].copy()

    on_time_num_mask = (
        (valid['days_before_promise'] >= 0) &
        (valid['transit_days'] >= 0)
    )
    on_time_den_mask = (
        on_time_num_mask |
        (
            (valid['days_late'] > 0) &
            (valid['transit_days'] >= 0)
        ) |
        (
            valid['Promised Date'].notna() &
            valid['Status'].str.strip().str.lower().isin([
                'returned to sender', 'return to sender', 'rts', 'returned', 'refused'
            ])
        ) |
        (
            (valid['days_past_due'] > 0) &
            valid['Status'].str.strip().str.lower().isin([
                'in transit', 'out for delivery', 'picked up', 'exception',
                'delivery exception', 'delayed', 'tendered', 'booked', 'dispatched',
                'pending', 'shipped', 'partially shipped', 'backordered',
                'short shipped', 'open', 'allocated', 'released', 'picked', 'packed'
            ])
        )
    )

    carriers = valid['Carrier'].dropna().unique()
    carrier_results = []

    for carrier in carriers:
        c_rows = valid[valid['Carrier'] == carrier]
        num = c_rows.loc[on_time_num_mask[c_rows.index], 'Shipment ID'].nunique()
        den = c_rows.loc[on_time_den_mask[c_rows.index], 'Shipment ID'].nunique()
        rate = num / den if den > 0 else float('nan')
        carrier_results.append({"name": str(carrier), "value": round(rate, 6)})

    carrier_results.sort(key=lambda x: -x['value'] if x['value'] == x['value'] else -1)

    overall_num = valid.loc[on_time_num_mask, 'Shipment ID'].nunique()
    overall_den = valid.loc[on_time_den_mask, 'Shipment ID'].nunique()
    overall_rate = overall_num / overall_den if overall_den > 0 else float('nan')

    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "Carrier",
        "metric_column": "Delivered At",
        "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "on_time_delivery",
        "results": carrier_results
    })

    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "Carrier",
        "metric_column": "Delivered At",
        "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "on_time_delivery_overall",
        "results": [{"name": "overall", "value": round(overall_rate, 6)}]
    })

    result['assumptions'].append(
        "on_time_delivery = distinct on-time shipments / distinct eligible shipments per domain rules; USD rows only, cancelled excluded"
    )
    result['assumptions'].append(
        f"Denominator includes delivered-on-time, delivered-late, RTS, and in-transit-past-due shipments; overall rate = {overall_rate:.4f}"
    )

except Exception as e:
    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "Carrier",
        "metric_column": "Delivered At",
        "aggregation": "ratio",
        "label": "on_time_delivery",
        "results": [{"name": "error", "value": float('nan')}]
    })
    result['assumptions'].append(f"Segmentation failed: {str(e)}")

    # Parse dates

        df_active[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_active[col], errors='coerce')

    # Determine last date in data
    last_date = df_active['Delivered Date'].max()

    # Define delivered status set
    delivered_statuses = {'delivered'}
    in_transit_statuses = {
        'in transit', 'out for delivery', 'picked up', 'exception',
        'delivery exception', 'delayed', 'tendered', 'booked', 'dispatched',
        'pending', 'shipped', 'partially shipped', 'backordered',
        'short shipped', 'open', 'allocated', 'released', 'picked', 'packed'
    }

    df_active['status_lower'] = df_active['Status'].str.lower().str.strip()

    # OTIF (order) denominator: distinct orders where delivered on time OR in transit
    # Condition: days_before_promise >= 0 (delivered on or before promise)
    #            OR days_late > 0 (delivered late)
    #            OR (days_past_due > 0 AND status in in_transit_statuses)
    denom_mask = (
        (df_active['days_before_promise'] >= 0) |
        (df_active['days_late'] > 0) |
        ((df_active['days_past_due'] > 0) & (df_active['status_lower'].isin(in_transit_statuses)))
    )
